title: One sentence: what broke and the mechanism, e.g. Prod deploy rolled back: migration outran the start timeout
short: Two to four words for the page title
summary: Four to six sentences: what happened, to whom, for how long, how it was fixed, what changes now.

impact.text: What customers and the business saw. Numbers over adjectives.

trigger: The event that started the impact.
detection: How and when the team found out, and why not sooner.
resolution: What stopped the impact, then what fixed it.

events.label: Error rate on /checkout passes 20%
events.detail: Optional sentence or two. `code` and [links](https://example.com) work.

events.label: Traffic shifted back to the old version

whys.problem: The impact a customer saw, the top of the tree

because.text: First answer to why. Under 140 characters.
because.evidence: Where this is shown: a log line, a graph, a [link](https://example.com)

because.text: Root cause: something the team can change that removes the whole class
A second cause of the same answer, its own branch
Why it was this bad: detection, blast radius or recovery
Root cause of the size of the impact

contributing: A condition that made it worse without causing it.

well: What worked and should be kept.
wrong: What failed or slowed the response.
lucky: What saved us that we cannot count on next time.

actions.what: Alert on X before customers see it

messaging.internal: The update posted to the team.
messaging.external: The update sent to customers, if any.
